description: This file is a shell script with embedded Python code, serving as a bootstrap script to clone and forward to the recipe engine tool, primarily used for managing dependencies and environment setup for the recipe engine in a build system.

classes.name: MalformedRecipesCfg
classes.description: Custom exception class for malformed recipes.cfg files.

classes.name: EngineDep
classes.description: Named tuple representing the recipe engine dependency with url, revision, and branch.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a recipes.cfg JSON file to extract engine dependency info and recipes path.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to extract recipe engine override and package path.

methods.name: checkout_engine
methods.description: Checks out the recipe engine repository based on the dependency info in recipes.cfg.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the bootstrap process, including environment setup and invoking the recipe engine.
